name: Arjun Mehta
text: PrismTutor Studio completely transformed my approach to mathematics. Dr. Chen's visual methods made calculus intuitive and even fun. I scored 98% in my board exams!

name: Lisa Patel
text: As a parent, I was amazed by the weekly progress reports and personalized attention my daughter received. Her confidence in science has skyrocketed since joining.

name: Ryan Torres
text: Prof. Wright's physics classes are next-level. The virtual lab experiments make everything click. I went from struggling with mechanics to topping my class.

name: Sneha Gupta
text: The coding course with Mr. Kumar is fantastic. I built my first Python project within a month! The step-by-step approach really works for beginners like me.

name: David Kim
text: The flexible scheduling and hybrid mode options made it possible for my son to attend despite his busy extracurricular schedule. Excellent value for money.

name: Ananya Reddy
text: Elena's creative writing workshops unlocked something in me. I've gone from hating essays to winning inter-school writing competitions. Truly life-changing!
